# Day

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/date/day` (default export). Day-of-month value (1–31) as `{ value }`, for recurring-schedule shapes where the month is not fixed.

## Usage
```ts
import DayField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/date/day';
```

The contained example shows the serialized shape.
